meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed initial plan, candidate and per-transfer hold checks against runtime/observability docs and backend skill. Holds stop locally before model-attempt evidence, short waits reread current health, explicit probes bypass the gate, and locked tools never replay. Credentials remain confined to private health state.

auth.review_note: Compared the profile rendering and saved HTTPS picture check to the authentication module guide. The guide documents the photo loading and JavaScript fallback cases.

commerce.review_note: Compared canonical optional fields, verified payment snapshots, historical flags, HSN groups and CSV review aggregation with the GST commerce guide.

content.review_note: Reviewed the two published customer Help articles against current templates and the BlogService and AdminHelpService handoff. Slugs, publication metadata and article rendering remain aligned with the content docs.

foundation.review_note: Checked architecture and private JSON storage against controller replay. Only accepted model responses use native presentation on replay and no replay refreshes business data or changes access scope.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed the frontend skill diff against its Google tag and reporting boundary. The added storefront verification covers product, category, cart and checkout controls and preserves public tag rendering and secret handling.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed the new hosting instructions against existing request-failure guidance. A transport receipt remains distinct from a rendering response, and the worker preserves the canonical queue before reporting an outcome.

interface.review_note: Compared mobile product geometry and two-decimal pricing with Design. The gallery remains uncropped and short-viewport keyboard focus has native scrolling clearance above an active cart tray.

mail.review_note: Reviewed Support controller failure and replay handling against email configuration and ticket boundaries. Verified outbound mail and persisted receipt handling remain separate from chat presentation.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed the revised Settings help alongside MCP client setup guidance. The change is confined to public Header menu guidance.

media.review_note: Compared active-chat restoration and attachment changes with the media operator instructions, and confirmed upload and in-memory draft attachment regressions pass.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed the merged owner and customer guide dependencies. The Enterprise order-count declaration advertises its existing role-scoped all-time choice. The unchanged public Help links describe the visible product stock, quantity, price and purchase actions, cart unit price and checkout review controls.

public-mcp.review_note: Checked removal of the question-to-A2UI heuristic alongside public MCP and A2UI details. Public and chat presenters consume typed authorized source evidence and selected published products.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed the product-detail layout and two-decimal price convention in Design. The checkout summaries, gateway callback and remote commerce contract remain governed by their existing resolved amounts.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed SettingsService module resolution and Merchant feed guidance. Dropping a retired header slot leaves the saved catalog eligibility inputs intact.

workflow.review_note: Compared the updated frontend skill with the source review and regeneration workflow. The new assertions describe existing native form routes and keyboard behavior without adding a tracker or changing release gates.
